## Requirements

### R1. CI/CD Matrix & Automated Multi-Platform Workflows
Implement comprehensive GitHub Actions automation across three separate workflows in `.github/workflows/`:
- Cross-platform test matrix (`ci.yml`) testing Linux (`ubuntu-latest`), macOS (`macos-latest`), and Windows (`windows-latest`) against Python versions 3.8 through 3.14, executing all test tiers.
- Android build & test automation (`android.yml`) setting up JDK 17 & Android SDK 34, running Java unit tests, validating the standalone zero-Gradle build script (`app/build.sh`), and linting release builds.
- Code quality & shell linting (`lint.yml`) validating all shell scripts (`.sh`), PowerShell scripts (`.ps1`), and Python syntax/imports.

### R2. Automated Release Workflow & Binary Decoupling
Decouple compiled binary artifacts from git version tracking while automating release distributions:
- Update `.gitignore` to omit pre-compiled APKs/JARs from future commits while preserving local builds.
- Implement release automation (`release.yml`) triggered on version tags (`v*.*.*`) that compiles signed `opentv.apk`, computes SHA256 checksums, and publishes a GitHub Release containing the launcher APK, standalone companion archive, and checksums.
- Update `README.md` to reference GitHub Releases for direct downloads.

### R3. Pure-Standard-Library mDNS & SSDP Local TV Auto-Discovery
Implement zero-configuration local network Android TV discovery in `companion/opentv/core/discovery.py` using strictly standard Python library sockets (`socket`, `struct`, `select` — zero third-party dependencies):
- Discover devices announcing ADB TLS/TCP mDNS services (`_adb._tcp.local`, `_adb-tls-connect._tcp.local`) and SSDP/DIAL multicast endpoints (`239.255.255.250:1900`).
- Add `--discover` flag to `opentv connect` and a "Scan Local Network" option in the interactive TUI.
- Provide unit and mock tests in `tests/` verifying multicast packet encoding and device resolution.

### R4. Friendly Package Name & Metadata Engine
Map cryptic Android package IDs to human-readable application names and categories across CLI, TUI, and debloat summaries:
- Implement `companion/opentv/core/app_names.py` with an embedded catalog of top ~250 Android TV packages and a tokenized fallback heuristic for unlisted reverse-domain identifiers.
- Integrate friendly name resolution into the TUI layout manager, app selector, and debloat reports (`[friendly name] (package.id) - [Category/Safety]`).
- Include test suites verifying exact mappings and fallback tokenizers.

### R5. Standalone Single-File Executables Distribution
Package the cross-platform companion into standalone zero-Python executables for non-technical users:
- Create `scripts/package_binaries.py` supporting pure-stdlib executable `zipapp` generation and PyInstaller recipes.
- Configure automated GitHub Actions packaging in `release.yml` for Windows x64 (`.exe`), macOS Universal, and Linux x86_64.
- Verify that packaged binaries launch directly into the interactive TUI.

### R6. Dynamic Debloat Definitions & Remote Definition Synchronization
Support dynamic external debloat rule updates without requiring app updates or compromising system safety:
- Refactor `companion/opentv/debloat/database.py` to merge local definitions with dynamic external JSON catalogs.
- Add `opentv debloat --update-definitions [--source <URL>]` with schema validation and cryptographic/structure verification.
- Enforce immutable fallback to hardcoded safety rules so core `never` packages can never be overridden or disabled.
- Include adversarial tests ensuring malformed or corrupted definitions cannot bypass guardrails.

### R7. Dynamic Sideload Banner Generator in Native Android Launcher
Enhance the Android TV launcher to dynamically generate high-quality 16:9 Leanback landscape banners for sideloaded mobile apps lacking TV banners:
- In `app/src/main/java/org/opentv/launcher/`, implement `BannerGenerator.java` detecting missing TV banners (`loadBanner == null`), extracting the app's primary color palette for a subtle gradient background, and centering the high-res square icon with clean typography.
- Implement memory-bounded bitmap caching for smooth 60fps remote navigation.
- Add JUnit tests in `app/src/test/java/` verifying aspect ratio, palette synthesis, and memory bounds.

### R8. Operational Constraints, TDD & Milestone Logging
- Maintain 100% Python 3 standard library compatibility (zero external pip packages in `companion/`).
- Enforce strict APK footprint ceiling: final release APK must remain under 60 KB.
- Maintain zero regressions across existing 235 tests and all new milestone test suites.
- Maintain a structured changelog in `CHANGELOG_DEV.md` logging progress, files changed, and test commands executed per milestone.

## Acceptance Criteria

### Milestone 1: CI/CD Workflows
- [ ] `.github/workflows/ci.yml` validates syntax and executes Python matrix across Linux, macOS, and Windows on Python 3.8–3.14.
- [ ] `.github/workflows/android.yml` runs Gradle unit tests, checks standalone `app/build.sh`, and validates release APK assembly.
- [ ] `.github/workflows/lint.yml` validates shell scripts, PowerShell scripts, and Python syntax.

### Milestone 2: Release Automation & Binary Decoupling
- [ ] `.gitignore` updated to decouple future binaries from git tree.
- [ ] `.github/workflows/release.yml` triggers on `v*` tags, signs APK, calculates SHA256 checksums, and attaches release assets.
- [ ] `README.md` references official GitHub Releases for downloads.

### Milestone 3: Auto-Discovery
- [ ] `companion/opentv/core/discovery.py` discovers local Android TVs via mDNS and SSDP without external pip dependencies.
- [ ] `opentv connect --discover` and TUI scan option find and connect to local TVs.
- [ ] Unit tests in `tests/test_discovery.py` pass with 100% mocked socket coverage.

### Milestone 4: Friendly Package Names
- [ ] `companion/opentv/core/app_names.py` resolves top ~250 TV apps to display names and categories with tokenized fallback.
- [ ] TUI and CLI debloat summaries render friendly names alongside package IDs.
- [ ] Unit tests pass for both known mappings and heuristic fallbacks.

### Milestone 5: Standalone Binary Packaging
- [ ] `scripts/package_binaries.py` successfully builds executable `zipapp` and PyInstaller distribution recipes.
- [ ] GitHub release workflow includes multi-platform standalone binary build steps.
- [ ] Packaged distribution launches directly into the interactive TUI.

### Milestone 6: Dynamic Debloat Definitions
- [ ] `opentv debloat --update-definitions` downloads and validates external definition catalogs.
- [ ] Immutable safety guardrails prevent any external file from overriding `never` packages.
- [ ] Adversarial tests pass confirming protection against corrupted or malicious definition schemas.

### Milestone 7: Dynamic Sideload Banner Generator
- [ ] `BannerGenerator.java` synthesizes 16:9 Leanback banners for sideloaded apps lacking landscape banners.
- [ ] Bitmap caching maintains smooth 60fps remote D-pad scrolling.
- [ ] JUnit tests pass verifying banner dimensions, color extraction, and memory bounds.
- [ ] Final release APK size remains strictly under 60 KB.

### Verification & Documentation
- [ ] `python3 tests/run_tests.py` passes all test tiers with 100% success rate.
- [ ] `gradle test` passes all Java unit tests.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG_DEV.md` contains entries for Milestones 1 through 7 with commands and outputs.
- [ ] `README.md` and `PROJECT.md` updated with all new commands and CI badges.

The discovery engine supports simultaneous mDNS (RFC 6762 / RFC 6763) and SSDP (UPnP 1.1 M-SEARCH) protocol scanning, DNS name pointer decompression (`0xc0`), cyclic pointer loop guards, case-insensitive UPnP header extraction, heuristic brand signature matching, non-TV device rejection, and numeric IPv4 octet deduplication.

319: - `companion/opentv/core/discovery.py`: Pure-stdlib local auto-discovery engine.
320:   - `DiscoveredDevice`: Unified dataclass model (`ip`, `port`, `hostname`, `device_type`, `model`, `source`, `raw_info`, `is_android`, `display_name`).

323:   - `parse_dns_response`: Binary DNS response unpacker for PTR (12), SRV (33), TXT (16), and A (1) records.
